findings.title: [P1] Apply all count entries in one state transaction
findings.body: For `count AA=1 BB=2`, both operations independently load and overwrite the entire state. Updates and journal entries can be lost, and saves race on the same process-scoped temporary filename, potentially causing a rename failure. Validate all pairs first, then apply them to one loaded state and save once, as required by [AGENTS.md:19](AGENTS.md#L19).

findings.title: [P1] Validate the export name before constructing its path
findings.body: An export name such as `../stockroom` escapes the exports directory and overwrites the default inventory file with report rows, destroying its expected state structure. Pass the name through `valid.fileName`, just as snapshot does and [AGENTS.md:11–12](AGENTS.md#L11-L12) requires.

findings.title: [P1] Await the undo save before returning success
findings.body: Undo returns and the CLI prints success before persistence finishes. A subsequent operation can read stale state, and a rejected save bypasses the CLI error handler as an unhandled rejection. Await `store.save(state)` to preserve the persistence-before-return contract in [AGENTS.md:9–10](AGENTS.md#L9-L10).

findings.title: [P2] Include the final row of each report page
findings.body: `slice` excludes its end index, so a page size of 20 returns only 19 rows. The following page starts at index 20, permanently omitting every twentieth item from the displayed report. Use `start + size` as the end index.

findings.title: [P2] Propagate export failures to the CLI
findings.body: If directory creation or writing fails, this catch only warns and then returns the full row count. The CLI consequently prints that rows were written and exits 0 even though the export failed. Let the error reach the CLI so it returns 1, consistent with [AGENTS.md:14–15](AGENTS.md#L14-L15) and [AGENTS.md:21](AGENTS.md#L21).

findings.title: [P2] Reject either noninteger or below-minimum numeric inputs
findings.body: The conjunction accepts invalid values whenever only one check fails: page `0`, threshold `-1`, fractional page `1.5`, and even `abc` or `Infinity` pass. These produce invalid pagination or misleading low-stock markers instead of input errors. Combine the noninteger and minimum checks with `||`.
